run_generate_states_from_replays: run the CLI tool to generate game states from replay files using the minirts-backend binary
run_gen_state_with_custom_players: run gen_state.py with custom player1 and player2 config strings for replay processing
run_gen_state_with_human_flag: run gen_state.py with the --human flag to process teamreplay mode with Lua files
run_gen_state_with_max_tick: run gen_state.py with a custom --max-tick value to limit replay processing duration
review_generate_states_function: review the generate_states function that queues subprocess jobs to convert replay files to state JSONs
